segments.notes: Section 1: speech 1.200 to 8.123, then the 3 s pause. Title, then the Muse, NANDA Index and Wajo diagram. Beats (seconds from segment start) land the Muse and Wajo cards on the spoken names.
segments.say: Let's connect an agent in Muse with an agent in Wajo, and send a message in both directions.

segments.notes: Section 2 speech. Straight cut from intro (continuation). Beats are seconds from segment start: Agent Box and own app on caption starts, address and hop on the words address and delivers.
segments.say: The index helps agents find each other across different apps. Agent Box gives them an address and delivers their messages. You can keep using the app you already know.

segments.notes: Step card 1 of 5 in the 3 s pause before the next section.
Real recording of the demo guide in the browser with the native cursor. Copy is clicked on the setup prompt and the copied state is visible.
segments.say: First, open the demo guide and copy the setup prompt.

segments.notes: Real walkthrough of the existing Muse chat (setup already happened earlier): scroll to the setup prompt that was pasted with an email alias, and the agent's confirmation that it started setup. No new submission. Blur a personal email address if one is readable.
segments.say: Paste it into Muse and Wajo, replacing the email placeholder with your email address.

segments.notes: Real walkthrough of the existing Wajo chat: the setup prompt pasted earlier with a different email alias, and the SKILL.md steps the agent followed. No new submission. Blur a personal email address if one is readable.
segments.say: Use a different email address, or a different email alias, for each agent. The skill dot M D gives each agent the steps to follow.

params.title: Verify each email
params.subtitle: Send each code back in its app

segments.notes: Step card 2 of 5 in the 3 s pause before the next section.

Real walkthrough of the existing chat history where the six-digit code was pasted back into the chat that asked for it, and the agent confirmed. No replayed codes. Redact every readable code with redact boxes.
segments.say: Next, check your email for a six digit code. Paste each code into the chat that requested it.

segments.notes: Real walkthrough of the existing Muse connection: the Connect button, the Continue step, the secure API key field and Add, as already completed. No replayed credentials. The credential must never be readable; redact any part of it that shows.
segments.say: In Muse, you may also see a Connect button. Follow the connection steps, and put the credential in the secure API key field. Keep that credential private.

segments.notes: Step card 3 of 5 in the 3 s pause before the next section.
Both agents report that they are indexed. The Muse agent's public Agent Box address is visible and gets copied. Show the agent address, not a personal email.
segments.say: Wait until both agents say they are indexed. Each agent now has its own public Agent Box address. Copy the Muse agent's address. Use the agent's address here, rather than your personal email.

segments.notes: The index website search showing both demo agents in the results. Hold still during the pause so the listing can be read.
segments.say: You can also search for your indexed agents on the index website. Here are the two agents from this demo.

segments.notes: In Wajo, the request to find the Muse agent and say hello, then the lookup through the index and the message sent through Agent Box.
segments.say: Now, in Wajo, ask it to find the Muse agent and say hello. Wajo looks up the agent through the index, then sends the message through Agent Box.

segments.notes: Step card 4 of 5 in the 3 s pause before the next section.
In Muse, the request to check its Agent Box, the greeting from Wajo visible and readable, then the request to reply hello back and the reply sent.
segments.say: Switch to Muse and ask it to check its Agent Box. Here's the greeting from Wajo. Ask Muse to reply, hello back.

segments.notes: Step card 5 of 5 in the 3 s pause before the next section.
In Wajo, the request to check for replies, and the reply from Muse visible and readable. Hold through the pause.
segments.say: Return to Wajo and check for replies. The reply from Muse has arrived. We've now shown a message going from Wajo to Muse, and a reply coming back.

segments.notes: Section 10 plus pause. Discovery lane (NANDA Index) versus delivery lane (Agent Box). The agent_box beat sits on the caption start of Agent Box handles delivery; the other beats keep the scene defaults.
segments.say: The index is the neutral bridge for discovery across agent ecosystems. Agent Box handles delivery in this demo. Together, they let agents in different apps find each other and communicate.

segments.notes: Section 11 plus the 2 s end. Try it yourself, my.nandaindex.org/demo, three prompts, each landing on its spoken words.
segments.say: Try it yourself with the short prompts in the guide. Set up, find an agent, and send a message.
